import os, json, urllib.request
email = os.environ.get('SCHOLAR_EMAIL', 'a.nikolaev@sheffield.ac.uk')
doi = '10.1523/JNEUROSCI.0808-13.2013'
url = f'https://api.crossref.org/works/{doi}'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': f'paper-downloader/1.0 (mailto:{email})'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
    data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
m = data['message']
print('TITLE:', m.get('title', ['(none)'])[0])
print('PUBLISHER:', m.get('publisher'))
print('YEAR:', m.get('issued', {}).get('date-parts', [[None]])[0][0])
print('PUBDATE:', m.get('published-print') or m.get('published-online'))
print('JOURNAL:', m.get('container-title', ['(none)'])[0])
print('VOLUME:', m.get('volume'))
print('ISSUE:', m.get('issue'))
print('PAGES:', m.get('page'))
print('TYPE:', m.get('type'))
print('ABSTRACT:', m.get('abstract', '(none)')[:500])
print('AUTHORS:')
for a in m.get('author', []):
    affs = [aff.get('name', '') for aff in a.get('affiliation', [])]
    print(f"  - {a.get('given', '')} {a.get('family', '')}", '| ORCID:', a.get('ORCID'), '| AFF:', affs)
print('LINKS:')
for l in m.get('link', []):
    print(f"  - {l.get('content-type')} | {l.get('URL')} | {l.get('intended-application')}")
